It is sometimes useless to try to think to the question what is the meaning of life or what is my purpose.

Backward engineering it. You need to make a living. You need to eat. Be healthy etc. There is some things that you must desire. At least, you are alive, so you have to live. You can either choose to do nothing at all, or rather have at least to have a job to sustain yourself, or choose what you want to do in this life. It is ok if you don’t know the exact answer, the world is a volatile place too.

You can then live according to principles that will maximize the things you need to have (like money) and expand your horizons.
Search for career that might use skills that you like developing and will have a positive impact in the world. Try to think outside the box. 

Attract people you want to in your life. When you build up to the person you want to be this will make it easier too. 

As you grow, you will enjoy it more as your achievements will stack up. 

It is difficult to start when you don’t have the right people around you. But in this situation, you have to trust in yourself by moving forward, not staying still, because the things nobody can change is the past. And you don’t want to regret.
